Tip: long press anywhere for settings

string-array.name: stoic_quotes
string-array.item: You have control over your actions only.
You do not need to react immediately to every thought.
Everything is fleeting; do not let it unsettle you.
The happiness of your life depends on the quality of your thoughts.
Do not seek for things to happen as you wish, but wish for them to happen as they do.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
Your mind is your only true refuge.
Death smiles at us all; all a man can do is smile back.

string-array.name: stoic_advice
string-array.item: Focus on what you can control
Accept fate with a calm mind
Don\'t react immediately, take time to think
Look for the fault in yourself first
Speak less, listen and act more
Your value lies in your character
Don\'t wish for things to be different
See an obstacle as an opportunity for growth
Do what is right, even in private
Be strict with yourself, kind to others
Don\'t waste time on things beyond your power
Remember that every moment is your last
Your happiness depends on the quality of your thoughts
Don\'t be a slave to your restless emotions
Everything external is indifferent to your soul
Always act in accordance with the common good
You don\'t need recognition from people you don\'t respect
Choose truth over a comfortable lie
Seek peace in your inner world
Live modestly and independent of property
Don\'t complain about what you cannot change
Every person is your fellow, be just
Your time is the most precious thing you have
Don\'t be swept away by the crowd into recklessness
Education without character is useless
Exercise your will on small things
Forgive others, be the best judge for yourself
Fear is only your own judgment
Nothing can hurt you without your consent
Today is all you truly own
Seek wisdom in books and in silence
Your actions speak louder than your words
Don\'t be curious about things that don\'t concern you
Control your desires, or they will control you
Be grateful for what you have right now
Death is a natural part of life, don\'t fear it
Patience is a manifestation of inner strength
Don\'t lose your calm because of others\' mistakes
Live in the present, not in the past
The truth hurts less than eternal deception
